text:
deploy-bot: kicking off config-only rollout r-e7c3. change-window 11:20-11:50 UTC. Canary: 4% for 10m (cohorted). Diffs: global_max_inflight: 150 -> 110, per_worker_threads: 12 -> 9, request_timeout_ms: 28000 -> 23000, batch_window_ms: 65 -> 48, routing.mode: round_robin -> latency_weighted. no model changes.
hana: ack. who's watching?
omar: i'll watch p50/p95/p99, 5xx and kvcache_miss. watching 11:22-11:35. :mag: 
tia: perf note: tightening batch_window historically bumped kvcache_miss for multi-shard tenants. we should cohort heavy tenants out of canary initially.
infra: added cohort plan: canary step1 4% limited to low-volume tenants, step2 manual to 25% including medium tenants if stable; heavy tenants pinned to old config for 30m. pin playbook in rollout notes.
deploy-bot: canary step1 applied at 3123456820. initial metrics +90s: p50=110ms p95=260ms p99=480ms 5xx=0.03% kvcache_miss=5.8%. no alerts.
omar: saw a short-lived p99 tail to ~710ms at 11:24 for ~40s, correlated with tenant burst T-511. isolated.
hana: ops, can you be ready to pin a tenant if the tail repeats?
infra: ready. pin command in runbook:
```
curl -XPOST "https://admin.internal/tenants/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant_id":"T-511","route":"stable-route","duration":"30m"}'
```
tia: adding rollback policy: auto-pause if p99_latency_ms > 650ms for 90s OR 5xx_rate_pct > 0.5 for 60s OR kvcache_miss_pct increases >10% absolute for 3m. rollout note snippet: 
```
{"rollback_conditions":[{"metric":"p99_latency_ms","threshold":650,"duration_s":90},{"metric":"5xx_rate_pct","threshold":0.5,"duration_s":60},{"metric":"kvcache_miss_pct_delta","threshold":10,"duration_s":180}]}
```
omar: after the transient tail, p99 settled to 490ms, p95 stable. kvcache_miss is 6.5% now. still below the miss delta rule.
hana: recommendation: hold at 4% for full 10m, then manual ramp to 25% for 8m if tails stay stable. prefer manual ramp to let us pin any repeating tenants.
deploy-bot: holding at 4% canary. 6m elapsed. latest: p50=105ms p95=245ms p99=500ms 5xx=0.02% kvcache_miss=6.6%. no auto-rollback triggered.
infra: if T-511 repeats, we'll pin and annotate traces using header X-Deploy-Rollout: r-e7c3 to filter easily.
tia: I'll update release notes with config diffs, cohort plan, rollback JSON, pin commands, observability tags, and change-window. :memo:
deploy-bot: canary hold complete at 3123456850. awaiting manual decision to proceed to step2 ramp to 25%.
